name: Elizabeth "Liz" Arnold

items.text: Before the August 2026 primary, PAC texts and signs said Liz Arnold and her husband were under animal-abuse investigation. The claims came from a February 2025 incident when he fired a shot at loose dogs attacking their poodle. A county animal-welfare case opened Aug. 3 was closed Aug. 13 with no violation substantiated.
items.why: The charge is about her husband's handling of a dog attack, and the county found no violation, so there is no conduct of hers that bears on criterion 6.

items.text: No foreign-government payments, foreign-agent filings or foreign-linked donors were found for Arnold.
items.why: Nothing was documented under criterion 2, so there is no conduct to weigh.

for_review: The Bradenton Times endorsed Arnold, and its reporting is the main source on the animal-welfare matter. I couldn't open the original sheriff's report or the county animal-welfare file. The Observer article (yourobserver.com, Aug. 26, 2026) wouldn't load when I fetched it. A search snippet from it matches the account of the dog attack, but I didn't use it as a source. The first Bradenton Times URL on the item list also failed to load, so I used a companion article by the same reporter. The one search on the owner's named sites, run with her name, returned nothing from those sites. I did not run a separate check for other issues, such as campaign finance, her business record or ethics complaints. She was elected Nov. 3, 2026, so there is no attendance record yet.
